Cypress Capital Group Has Increased Its Laboratory America Hldgs (LH) Stake; Night Owl Capital Management Decreased Stake in Starbucks (SBUX) by $2.66 Million
April 30, 2018 - By Marguerite Chambers
John Kim decreased its stake in Starbucks (SBUX) by 33.75% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Night Owl Capital Management Llc sold 46,753 shares as the company’s stock rose 0.28% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund run by John Kim held 91,786 shares of the restaurants company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $5.27M, down from 138,539 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Night Owl Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Starbucks for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $81.10B market cap company. The stock decreased 1.14% or $0.665 $57.695. About 5.06M shares traded. Starbucks Corporation (NASDAQ:SBUX) has risen 0.40% uptrending. It has underperformed by 11.15% the S&P500.
Cypress Capital Group increased its stake in Laboratory Corp America Hldgs (LH) by 40.96% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Cypress Capital Group bought 2,200 shares as the company’s stock rose 1.25% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 7,571 shares of the medical specialities company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $1.21M, up from 5,371 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Cypress Capital Group who had been investing in Laboratory Corp America Hldgs for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $17.48B market cap company. The stock decreased 1.79% or $3.13 $171.39. About 503,482 shares traded. Laboratory Corporation of America Holdings (NYSE:LH) has risen 14.17% uptrending. It has outperformed by 2.62% the S&P500.
